text:
**My pick: Anker 735 Charger (Nano II 65W), about $29.99.** Anker's 65W 3-port charger is the Editor's Choice in both Laptopbee roundups ([65W chargers](https://www.laptopbee.com/best-65w-usb-c-chargers/), [laptop chargers](https://www.laptopbee.com/best-usb-c-laptop-chargers/)).

- **Buy:** [Anker 735 at Newegg, $29.99](https://www.newegg.com/p/359-00D8-002C3). The listing has several style options (charger only, or charger plus a 10ft cable), so check which one you've selected.
- **Ports:** 2 USB-C and 1 USB-A, with PPS for fast charging on Samsung phones.
- **Power:** Either USB-C port gives the full 65W when it's the only device plugged in ([Anker specs](https://service.anker.com/product-description/a085g000004x2BVAAY)).
- **Warranty:** 18 months.

**Alternatives**

- **UGREEN Nexode Pro 65W:** Smart Gadget Kit's top overall pick. It's a 113g charger with 3 ports and US/UK/EU plug heads, which is handy for travel ([review](https://smartgadgetkit.com/best-gan-charger/)). The search results had no price or direct buy link for it, so check current pricing there.
- **Baseus GaN5 Pro 65W (2-pack), $49.99:** This is a good deal if you want one charger for home and one for your bag. It supports PPS and gives 65W from either USB-C port when used alone ([Dealectric listing](https://dealectric.com/baseus-gan5-pro-65w-2c-u)). It has an 18–24 month warranty. That link is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you.

**Caveat for all of them:** The 65W only applies when you charge one device. With a laptop and phone plugged in together, the split is about 45W + 20W on the Anker and UGREEN, and about 45W + 20W on the Baseus too. That's enough for a MacBook Air or Dell XPS 13, but a 65W-hungry laptop will charge more slowly. If you plan to charge both at once, a 100W charger is better, such as the Anker Prime 100W that Smart Gadget Kit recommends for MacBook Pro users.

What laptop do you have? If it needs a full 65W while the phone is also charging, I can narrow this down.
